summary.text: Tony Hampton is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 62 since 2025 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hampton previously served as sheriff of Scott County for 14 years.

paragraphs.text: Tony Hampton's career experience includes working in law enforcement, and he was the sheriff of Scott County for 14 years.
He graduated from the Department of Criminal Justice in 1995.
Hampton assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Phillip Pratt (R).
In the 2025-2026 session he served on the House Banking and Insurance, Local Government, and Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations committees.
